purpose: The canonical 13-scene benchmark layout that every P8/P9/P10 method must consume via baseline_closure/adapters/dataset_adapter.py. This layout supersedes the P5-era per-baseline dataset trees (including the manually-created garden variant, whose caveat is retired going forward).
scene_split: official --eval train/test split per data/datasets/official_training_datasets.json; FINAL-30K protocol final eval = all cameras at iteration 30000.

local_windows.note: Local tree is a partial mirror: datasets has bicycle/bonsai/counter/garden/kitchen/room only; official cameras present for bicycle/garden/room only. Full 13-scene runs happen on the mx host.

remote_mx.note: All 13 scenes present (verified by _mx_check_sparse.py); layout <scene>/{images, sparse/0/{cameras.bin, images.bin, points3D.bin}}.

resolution_conventions.matched_protocol_p8: GTDataset resolution='1080p' (target 1920x1080 via benchmark_framework.resize_cameras); per-scene effective sizes recorded in run provenance.
resolution_conventions.graphdeco_family_p9_native: -i images with -r -1 auto-1600px (b0/taming/speedy/fastgs upstream behavior); no override applied.
